name: Fusion Fundamental v4
description: fusion-fundamental-v0 plus shorting: when the valuation gap is deeply negative AND confidence clears a stricter, dedicated bar (shorting is a materially higher-risk move than sizing a long — capped downside vs. theoretically unbounded), opens a conservatively-sized short instead of only flattening to cash. Tuned hysteresis/rebalance-tolerance from a real July-August 2026 parameter sweep. Requires config.risk.allowShortSelling to actually take effect; behaves identically to v0 in a plain cash-only match.
